result.summary: REQ-027 ships Letflow's definition core schema: the two tables R-Co's src/design/definition.md names as store.zig's DB-backed CRUD surface, ported as two migrations (priv/repo/migrations/20260816193001_create_process_definitions.exs, 20260816193002_create_instance_definition_snapshots.exs) plus two Ecto.Schema modules under lib/letflow/definitions/ (process_definition.ex, instance_definition_snapshot.ex). Both tables are schema-per-tenant via Ecto's :prefix -- neither targets the public default schema -- and both migrations carry BOTH mandatory halves of REQ-022 design section 4's guard pattern: the change/0 body wrapped in `if prefix() do ... end`, AND registration of the {version, module, filename} triple in Letflow.TenantProvisioning's tenant_scoped_migrations/0 manifest (entries 8 and 9), since a guarded migration that is never registered is inert rather than merely unbookkept. Three of process_definitions' indexes are constraints, not lookup aids: uq_definition_version (plain unique on (name, version)), which REQ-030's ON CONFLICT (name, version) will use as its arbiter; uq_active_definition (PARTIAL unique on name WHERE status = 'active'), which carries PD-03's single-active-per-name invariant at the migration layer independently of REQ-030's activate/1, so the invariant holds before the activation code that respects it even exists; and idx_def_stage (partial on stage WHERE stage IS NOT NULL), ported verbatim from PD-07's 014_definition_stage.sql so the null majority is never indexed. instance_definition_snapshots' FK to process_definitions.id is declared on_delete: :nothing -- deliberately WITHOUT ON DELETE CASCADE per PD-08, so a hard-deleted DRAFT definition cannot drag away the historical record of what a running instance actually started from; that negative property was verified from the live Postgres catalog rather than from migration source (pg_constraint.confdeltype = 'a' NO ACTION on instance_definition_snapshots_definition_id_fkey, confirmed not 'c'/'n'/'d', plus a real DELETE probe). Scope is schema only, stated in both moduledocs: graph/node/edge validation (REQ-028/029), CRUD (REQ-030) and snapshot create/retrieve (REQ-033) are separate later requirements building on these tables. All WF-02 gates PASS, with RELEASE-VALIDATOR re-running the suite itself rather than trusting Step 4: 6 of 6 runs clean at 307/307 (4 properties, 303 tests), zero reds, the delta from the run's recorded 271 baseline reconciling exactly against REQ-027's own 36 new tests with no unexplained gap. This Step 6 pass flipped docs/requirements.yaml REQ-027 status in_progress -> done (that field only, that requirement only) and appended one done event to docs/status/requirement_status.yaml (append-only, verified pure additions: git diff --numstat reports 77 added / 0 deleted, so every prior entry is byte-identical; both files re-validated as parsing YAML). README.md and docs/migration/stage-2-event-store-definitions.md were each assessed and BOTH deliberately left untouched, with reasons recorded in the status note. No lib/, priv/, test/ or design file was touched by this pass -- all had already cleared hard gates earlier in the run.
